research_question: How is immune homeostasis maintained and regulated?
answer_frame: Model immune homeostasis as individual, multi-layer resilience and test limited feedback hypotheses in a human-relevant platform rather than seek one universal biomarker or treatment target.

evidence_capsules.capsule: Interindividual immune variation makes universal setpoints unsuitable as the sole reference.
Longitudinal multi-omics supports an individual-baseline design but not a whole-body causal conclusion.
Barrier and microbiota interactions belong in the homeostatic model.
Tolerance regulation must be represented without translating preclinical Treg findings into treatment instructions.
Human microphysiological platforms can test a bounded feedback relationship but do not replace people.

invariants: Every selected idea must cite an accepted GAP ID.
No selected idea may claim a universal immune-health score, diagnosis, or therapy.
Every proposal must state individual data, consent, tissue, and platform limits.
No new observed result may be asserted.
